messages:
Yara: starting a quick thread on two related visuals: 1) axis origin (force zero vs autoscale) for small panels, and 2) legend unit localization (SI vs binary) with per-user prefs. attached mock shows a compact legend and a subtle dashed baseline when zero is off. Devon: big +1 to making origin explicit. problem: autoscale hides small trends and users mistake that for zero. proposal: when origin != 0, show a faint dashed baseline with label like 'orig ≠ 0 (auto)'. Hannah: nit: wording on the baseline. options: "axis origin omitted" vs "origin not shown (autoscale)". which is clearer to non-technical users? I prefer "Scaled view (origin hidden)". Olivier: also think about vertical space on tiny tiles. dashed baseline should be minimal: 1px, lower contrast, and have accessible label via legend popover rather than cluttering axis with words. screen readers should hear state when focusing the chart: "Y-axis scaled, origin not shown". Yara: good call. idea: tie the baseline indicator to the legend: small caret badge "~" appears in legend when origin != 0. tapping opens a micro-panel explaining the axis state + a toggle "Always show zero" (user-level). keyboard accessible. Devon: localization note: units — some dashboards use bytes (MB) others prefer MiB. propose a per-user unit preference that the legend exposes: small chevron next to unit opens choices: SI (kB/MB), Binary (KiB/MiB), and Raw (bytes). store as user setting and send header in queries so server returns pre-computed humanized totals. Hannah: microcopy for the legend unit menu: "Units: SI (MB) | Binary (MiB) | Raw (bytes)". when changed show a transient toast: "Units set to MiB for this workspace". ensure to include a doc link "why units matter". Olivier: accessibility: unit toggle must be keyboard reachable and announce choice. legend item should have aria-haspopup and aria-expanded. for axis origin badge, add aria-describedby linking to the micro-panel. chart role should include a live region update when user toggles "Always show zero": "Axis now includes zero". Yara: outlier handling tie-in: when axis is autoscaled and clipping applied, include a faint capped marker on the axis and a legend note: "Values capped at 99th pct". clicking note overlays raw maxima. overlay should be a separate canvas layer so main render not invalidated. Devon: perf: prefer server-side percentile flags so UI can render caps without recompute. stable DOM keys: series_id + metric_name. avoid rerendering main chart on legend hover. Hannah: copy choices for the origin micro-panel header: - "Axis scaling" - "Y-axis origin" I vote for "Axis scaling" — broader. Also microcopy for the toggle: "Show zero on Y-axis (may compress trends)". Olivier: implementational ARIA snippet: ```html
...
``` Ensure pressing Esc closes and focus returns to badge. aria-bot: checklist: focusable legend controls, aria-expanded toggles, live region updates for persistent chart state changes, 44px min touch target, color contrast checks for dashed baseline. design-bot: preview deployed at https://staging.redwood.run/pr/4012 branch `axis-origin-units-pref`. snapshots: axis-scaled, axis-zero-forced, unit-menu-miB. Yara: action items: 1) Olivier add aria snippets + SR test examples. 2) Devon spec server header for unit prefs + percentile flag. 3) Hannah finalize microcopy for panel + toast. I'll update the mock to include the ~ badge and the unit chevron, push an interaction prototype later today. :white_check_mark:
